my company gives me 5 lakh group cover, so why would I pay extra

That's a common view. While many companies offer group cover, the median employer health cover is about ₹3 lakh (≈$3,100) according to a 2023 Plum survey, so 5 lakh is above average but not universal. Also, employer cover belongs to the employer's group policy, and the regulator only allows moving it into your own name when you exit the group (IRDAI's 2020 circular). What concerns you most about relying solely on the group policy?
